review.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent; 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic assessment of observed emulated landscape mobile play only, not a win/loss grade or physical-device certification. Overall is a judgment, not an arithmetic average.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, atmospheric, finishable mission with strong objective assistance, offset by uncertain targeting and crowded low-contrast combat information. Two assisted wins establish observed completion, not comprehensive mobile polish.
reasons.controls: Large anchored controls, working manual forward movement, visible DASH cooldown and AIM sight transition. Scene drag and small FIRE corrections changed view. Enemy tap aim felt inconsistent; repeated misses/cover made corrective intent hard to judge. Manual precision, sustained dual-thumb combat, JUMP and TOOLS remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coils and upload provide distinct objectives with clear progress. Enemy charge/fire warnings add pressure and coil windows create timing decisions. Assisted travel dominated; several waits under rear fire and bursts into cover felt repetitive. Broader combat depth and continuous enjoyment unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong rainy cyan/amber industrial atmosphere, consistent typography and restrained result screen. Repeated concrete forms and dark enemies sometimes blend together. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook explains ROUTE, recovery, tap aim and coil windows; contextual hold control and SAVED confirmation were helpful. Map pauses, shows route length/legend and closed visibly. Numerous right-side controls and transient threat messages divide attention. Handbook lower instructions clipped at initial landscape view with a swipe cue; full lower content was not explored.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, objective and numbered coil status are legible. Small thin compass, map labels, environmental text and low-contrast enemy silhouettes demand scrutiny at 844x390; threat banners and weapon can obscure the scene.

frustratingMoments.detail: ROUTE plus FIRE changed position/view while sentinel remained off reticle; next attempt mostly separated these actions.
NO IMPACT after target tap/reload burst; moving sentinel stayed left of reticle. Cause not established.
AIM sharpened sight picture but burst still returned COVER with enemies right of reticle.
Rear damage warning while facing coils; target progress and defense competed for attention.

uncertainties: No isolated diagnosis of misses: movement, cover, tap geometry and targeting behavior could contribute. No source inspection.
Coil III fell from 100% to 58% in a batch whose captured end showed ARMORED; cannot identify precise phase at each shot from paused images.
Cumulative play time is a visible label on results but no separate numeric cumulative value shown; only displayed mission times are recorded.
No performance/FPS measurement, audio assessment, physical comfort assessment or inference about unplayed memory content.
